what: Long work as a job (agent_job.py start/list/status/progress/stop): an own background run of the same command that survives a restart of the runner, reports to a Kalmido job (progress, steps), posts its result with its outbox files into the chat and wakes the chat agent (job_wake, 2.46.6); the brief is played in again after a compaction; a plan limit waits for the reset and resumes the same session (--resume, at most 3 times); Stop of the job stops the process; optional git worktree per job with a cap; --name gives the job its own name (2.58.0); 2.1406.0 (#4063): a reminder before the time limit (JOB-NOTES.md, commit, comment), never a follow-up job by itself
